detached_structure.evidence: A dark-roofed rectangular building sits just southeast of the central house, with a paved area between them. It could be a detached garage or a neighboring house, so it is uncertain.
detached_structure.detail: Possible detached garage or neighboring dwelling

signals.notes: The central gray-roofed house has a paved side or rear area and hedges along its north side; the dark structure to the southeast may belong to a neighboring lot, and the mature trees to the east and south partly shade the surroundings.
